name: Osskai Matcha-Honey Praline Bar
description: A layered praline bar with a synth-nut base, matcha-infused cocoa-analog coating, and a honey-flavored synth-caramel center — positioned as an accessible mid-tier indulgence from one of M88's largest candy manufacturers.
flavor_profile: Grassy, slightly bitter matcha upfront, giving way to a sweet honey caramel center with a gentle nuttiness throughout; smooth melt with a slightly waxy finish from the cocoa-analog coating
cultural_context: The Osskai bar is the default 'treat yourself' purchase for Tier 2 workers — familiar enough to be comforting, interesting enough to feel like a small luxury; its green-gold wrapper is instantly recognizable across M88.
story_hooks: Osskai's matcha supplier is caught using synthetic matcha compound with none of the real botanical content — the bar has been fraudulent for years and Halvek Group buried the tests.
A limited 'reserve' batch using trace amounts of real honey becomes a black-market item after Halvek discontinues it, with collectors paying ten times face value.
A Tier 1 child who finds an Osskai wrapper is mistakenly believed by a Shelf gang to be carrying a corponation message — the wrapper is used as gang-adjacent currency.
